1.name: Bulbasaur
1.description: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.
1.text: Bulbasaur! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A grass and poison type Pokémon. While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

2.name: Ivysaur
2.description: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength.
2.text: Ivysaur! Bulbasaur's second evolutionary stage. A grass and poison type Pokémon. Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength.

3.name: Venusaur
3.description: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower.
3.text: Venusaur! Bulbasaur's third evolutionary stage. A grass and poison type Pokémon. A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower.

4.name: Charmander
4.description: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail.
4.text: Charmander! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A fire type Pokémon. From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail.

5.name: Charmeleon
5.description: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.
5.text: Charmeleon! Charmander's second evolutionary stage. A fire type Pokémon. If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

6.name: Charizard
6.description: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet.
6.text: Charizard! Charmander's third evolutionary stage. A fire and flying type Pokémon. Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet.

7.name: Squirtle
7.description: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.
7.text: Squirtle! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A water type Pokémon. When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

8.name: Wartortle
8.description: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.
8.text: Wartortle! Squirtle's second evolutionary stage. A water type Pokémon. It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

9.name: Blastoise
9.description: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.
9.text: Blastoise! Squirtle's third evolutionary stage. A water type Pokémon. The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.

10.name: Caterpie
10.description: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
10.text: Caterpie! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A bug type Pokémon. Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

11.name: Metapod
11.description: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender.
11.text: Metapod! Caterpie's second evolutionary stage. A bug type Pokémon. Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender.

12.name: Butterfree
12.text: Butterfree! Caterpie's third evolutionary stage. A bug and flying type Pokémon. It collects honey every day.

13.name: Weedle
13.description: Beware of the sharp stinger on its head.
13.text: Weedle! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A bug and poison type Pokémon. Beware of the sharp stinger on its head.

14.name: Kakuna
14.text: Kakuna! Weedle's second evolutionary stage. A bug and poison type Pokémon. Able to move only slightly.

15.name: Beedrill
15.description: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail.
15.text: Beedrill! Weedle's third evolutionary stage. A bug and poison type Pokémon. It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail.

16.name: Pidgey
16.text: Pidgey! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A normal and flying type Pokémon. Very docile.

17.name: Pidgeotto
17.description: This Pokémon is full of vitality.
17.text: Pidgeotto! Pidgey's second evolutionary stage. A normal and flying type Pokémon. This Pokémon is full of vitality.

18.name: Pidgeot
18.description: This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey.
18.text: Pidgeot! Pidgey's third evolutionary stage. A normal and flying type Pokémon. This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey.

19.name: Rattata
19.description: Will chew on anything with its fangs.
19.text: Rattata! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A normal type Pokémon. Will chew on anything with its fangs.

20.name: Raticate
20.text: Raticate! Rattata's second evolutionary stage. A normal type Pokémon. Its hind feet are webbed.

21.name: Spearow
21.text: Spearow! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A normal and flying type Pokémon. Inept at flying high.

22.name: Fearow
22.description: A Pokémon that dates back many years.
22.text: Fearow! Spearow's second evolutionary stage. A normal and flying type Pokémon. A Pokémon that dates back many years.

23.name: Ekans
23.description: The older it gets, the longer it grows.
23.text: Ekans! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A poison type Pokémon. The older it gets, the longer it grows.

24.name: Arbok
24.description: The frightening patterns on its belly have been studied.
24.text: Arbok! Ekans's second evolutionary stage. A poison type Pokémon. The frightening patterns on its belly have been studied.

25.name: Pikachu
25.description: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity.
25.text: Pikachu! Pichu's second evolutionary stage. An electric type Pokémon. Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity.

26.name: Raichu
26.description: If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail to gather electricity from the atmosphere.
26.text: Raichu! Pichu's third evolutionary stage. An electric type Pokémon. If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail to gather electricity from the atmosphere.

27.name: Sandshrew
27.description: It burrows into the ground to create its nest.
27.text: Sandshrew! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A ground type Pokémon. It burrows into the ground to create its nest.

28.name: Sandslash
28.description: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws.
28.text: Sandslash! Sandshrew's second evolutionary stage. A ground type Pokémon. It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws.

29.name: Nidoran♀
29.description: It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eat berries.
29.text: Nidoran♀! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A poison type Pokémon. It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eat berries.

30.name: Nidorina
30.description: If the group is threatened, these Pokémon will band together to assault enemies with a chorus of ultrasonic waves.
30.text: Nidorina! Nidoran♀'s second evolutionary stage. A poison type Pokémon. If the group is threatened, these Pokémon will band together to assault enemies with a chorus of ultrasonic waves.

31.name: Nidoqueen
31.description: It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps between the spines on its back.
31.text: Nidoqueen! Nidoran♀'s third evolutionary stage. A poison and ground type Pokémon. It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps between the spines on its back.

32.name: Nidoran♂
32.description: Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold its ground and even risk its life in battle to protect the female it’s friendly with.
32.text: Nidoran♂! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A poison type Pokémon. Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold its ground and even risk its life in battle to protect the female it’s friendly with.

33.name: Nidorino
33.description: It’s nervous and quick to act aggressively.
33.text: Nidorino! Nidoran♂'s second evolutionary stage. A poison type Pokémon. It’s nervous and quick to act aggressively.

34.name: Nidoking
34.description: Nidoking prides itself on its strength.
34.text: Nidoking! Nidoran♂'s third evolutionary stage. A poison and ground type Pokémon. Nidoking prides itself on its strength.

35.name: Clefairy
35.description: It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night.
35.text: Clefairy! Cleffa's second evolutionary stage. A fairy type Pokémon. It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night.

36.name: Clefable
36.description: Legend says that on clear, quiet nights, it listens for the voices of its kin living on the moon.
36.text: Clefable! Cleffa's third evolutionary stage. A fairy type Pokémon. Legend says that on clear, quiet nights, it listens for the voices of its kin living on the moon.

37.name: Vulpix
37.description: In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs.
37.text: Vulpix! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A fire type Pokémon. In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs.

38.name: Ninetales
38.description: The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent.
38.text: Ninetales! Vulpix's second evolutionary stage. A fire type Pokémon. The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent.

39.name: Jigglypuff
39.description: By freely changing the wavelength of its voice, Jigglypuff sings a mysterious melody sure to make any listener sleepy.
39.text: Jigglypuff! Igglybuff's second evolutionary stage. A normal and fairy type Pokémon. By freely changing the wavelength of its voice, Jigglypuff sings a mysterious melody sure to make any listener sleepy.

40.name: Wigglytuff
40.description: It’s proud of its fur, which is fine and delicate.
40.text: Wigglytuff! Igglybuff's third evolutionary stage. A normal and fairy type Pokémon. It’s proud of its fur, which is fine and delicate.

41.name: Zubat
41.description: Makes its home in gloomy caves.
41.text: Zubat! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A poison and flying type Pokémon. Makes its home in gloomy caves.

42.name: Golbat
42.description: Every once in a while, you’ll see a Golbat that’s missing some fangs.
42.text: Golbat! Zubat's second evolutionary stage. A poison and flying type Pokémon. Every once in a while, you’ll see a Golbat that’s missing some fangs.

43.name: Oddish
43.description: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun.
43.text: Oddish! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A grass and poison type Pokémon. During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun.

44.name: Gloom
44.description: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey.
44.text: Gloom! Oddish's second evolutionary stage. A grass and poison type Pokémon. What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey.

45.name: Vileplume
45.description: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains.
45.text: Vileplume! Oddish's third evolutionary stage. A grass and poison type Pokémon. The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains.

46.name: Paras
46.description: Sometimes seen at the foot of trees in humid forests.
46.text: Paras! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A bug and grass type Pokémon. Sometimes seen at the foot of trees in humid forests.

47.name: Parasect
47.description: The bug host is drained of energy by the mushroom on its back.
47.text: Parasect! Paras's second evolutionary stage. A bug and grass type Pokémon. The bug host is drained of energy by the mushroom on its back.

48.name: Venonat
48.description: Its large eyes act as radar.
48.text: Venonat! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A bug and poison type Pokémon. Its large eyes act as radar.

49.name: Venomoth
49.description: The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove from skin.
49.text: Venomoth! Venonat's second evolutionary stage. A bug and poison type Pokémon. The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove from skin.

50.name: Diglett
50.description: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth.
50.text: Diglett! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A ground type Pokémon. It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth.

51.name: Dugtrio
51.description: These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level.
51.text: Dugtrio! Diglett's second evolutionary stage. A ground type Pokémon. These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level.

52.name: Meowth
52.description: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless.
52.text: Meowth! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A normal type Pokémon. It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless.

53.name: Persian
53.description: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker.
53.text: Persian! Meowth's second evolutionary stage. A normal type Pokémon. Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker.

54.name: Psyduck
54.text: Psyduck! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A water type Pokémon. Suffers perpetual headaches.

55.name: Golduck
55.description: Its body is strong, and it has webbing on its hands and feet.
55.text: Golduck! Psyduck's second evolutionary stage. A water type Pokémon. Its body is strong, and it has webbing on its hands and feet.

56.name: Mankey
56.description: An agile Pokémon that lives in trees.
56.text: Mankey! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A fighting type Pokémon. An agile Pokémon that lives in trees.

57.name: Primeape
57.description: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around.
57.text: Primeape! Mankey's second evolutionary stage. A fighting type Pokémon. It stops being angry only when nobody else is around.

58.name: Growlithe
58.description: They patrol their territory in pairs.
58.text: Growlithe! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A fire type Pokémon. They patrol their territory in pairs.

59.name: Arcanine
59.description: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame.
59.text: Arcanine! Growlithe's second evolutionary stage. A fire type Pokémon. Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame.

60.name: Poliwag
60.description: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.
60.text: Poliwag! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A water type Pokémon. In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.

61.name: Poliwhirl
61.description: This Pokémon’s sweat is a slimy mucus.
61.text: Poliwhirl! Poliwag's second evolutionary stage. A water type Pokémon. This Pokémon’s sweat is a slimy mucus.

62.name: Poliwrath
62.description: Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts.
62.text: Poliwrath! Poliwag's third evolutionary stage. A water and fighting type Pokémon. Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts.

63.name: Abra
63.description: Spends 18 hours of the day sleeping.
63.text: Abra! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A psychic type Pokémon. Spends 18 hours of the day sleeping.

64.name: Kadabra
64.description: There are rumors that a child with mystical powers became a Kadabra; however, this remains unverified.
64.text: Kadabra! Abra's second evolutionary stage. A psychic type Pokémon. There are rumors that a child with mystical powers became a Kadabra; however, this remains unverified.

65.name: Alakazam
65.description: The longer Alakazam lives, the larger and heavier its head becomes.
65.text: Alakazam! Abra's third evolutionary stage. A psychic type Pokémon. The longer Alakazam lives, the larger and heavier its head becomes.

66.name: Machop
66.description: Though as small as a child, it has strength enough to easily throw a well-built adult.
66.text: Machop! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A fighting type Pokémon. Though as small as a child, it has strength enough to easily throw a well-built adult.

67.name: Machoke
67.description: A sturdy creature boasting a robust physique and boundless stamina.
67.text: Machoke! Machop's second evolutionary stage. A fighting type Pokémon. A sturdy creature boasting a robust physique and boundless stamina.

68.name: Machamp
68.description: In close combat, its four arms afford it offensive and defensive supremacy.
68.text: Machamp! Machop's third evolutionary stage. A fighting type Pokémon. In close combat, its four arms afford it offensive and defensive supremacy.

69.name: Bellsprout
69.text: Bellsprout! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A grass and poison type Pokémon. Prefers hot and humid places.

70.name: Weepinbell
70.description: When hungry, it swallows anything that moves.
70.text: Weepinbell! Bellsprout's second evolutionary stage. A grass and poison type Pokémon. When hungry, it swallows anything that moves.

71.name: Victreebel
71.description: Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey.
71.text: Victreebel! Bellsprout's third evolutionary stage. A grass and poison type Pokémon. Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey.

72.name: Tentacool
72.description: They fire beams from the glassy, magenta orbs that resemble eyes atop their heads, and they drift in shallow seas.
72.text: Tentacool! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A water and poison type Pokémon. They fire beams from the glassy, magenta orbs that resemble eyes atop their heads, and they drift in shallow seas.

73.name: Tentacruel
73.description: It has 80 tentacles, each with a venomous tip.
73.text: Tentacruel! Tentacool's second evolutionary stage. A water and poison type Pokémon. It has 80 tentacles, each with a venomous tip.

74.name: Geodude
74.description: Makes its home in mountainous regions, using its arms to climb along harsh mountain roads.
74.text: Geodude! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A rock and ground type Pokémon. Makes its home in mountainous regions, using its arms to climb along harsh mountain roads.

75.description: Dwells in holes dug into sheer walls of stone.

76.description: The rocklike shell is shed each year.

77.name: Ponyta
77.description: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland.
77.text: Ponyta! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A fire type Pokémon. These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland.

78.name: Rapidash
78.description: Fiery mane aglow, Rapidash darts like an arrow across the land.
78.text: Rapidash! Ponyta's second evolutionary stage. A fire type Pokémon. Fiery mane aglow, Rapidash darts like an arrow across the land.

79.name: Slowpoke
79.description: When this Pokémon’s tail is soaked in water, sweetness seeps from it.
79.text: Slowpoke! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A water and psychic type Pokémon. When this Pokémon’s tail is soaked in water, sweetness seeps from it.

80.name: Slowbro
80.description: Being bitten by a Shellder shocked this Pokémon into standing on two legs.
80.text: Slowbro! Slowpoke's second evolutionary stage. A water and psychic type Pokémon. Being bitten by a Shellder shocked this Pokémon into standing on two legs.

81.name: Magnemite
81.description: A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere.
81.text: Magnemite! The first stage of its evolutionary family. An electric and steel type Pokémon. A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere.

82.description: Three Magnemite gathered to evolve into this Pokémon.
82.text: Magneton! Magnemite's second evolutionary stage. An electric and steel type Pokémon. Three Magnemite gathered to evolve into this Pokémon.

83.description: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way.

84.name: Doduo
84.description: Its short wings make flying difficult.
84.text: Doduo! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A normal and flying type Pokémon. Its short wings make flying difficult.

85.name: Dodrio
85.description: One of Doduo’s two heads splits to form a unique species.
85.text: Dodrio! Doduo's second evolutionary stage. A normal and flying type Pokémon. One of Doduo’s two heads splits to form a unique species.

86.name: Seel
86.text: Seel! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A water type Pokémon. Loves freezing-cold conditions.

90.text: Shellder! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A water type Pokémon. Its hard shell repels any kind of attack.

91.name: Cloyster

91.text: Cloyster! Shellder's second evolutionary stage. A water and ice type Pokémon. Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.

92.name: Gastly
92.text: Gastly! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A ghost and poison type Pokémon. Gaseous and completely impalpable.

93.description: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, Haunter is there.
93.text: Haunter! Gastly's second evolutionary stage. A ghost and poison type Pokémon. If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, Haunter is there.

94.description: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives.
94.text: Gengar! Gastly's third evolutionary stage. A ghost and poison type Pokémon. Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives.

95.name: Onix
95.description: This chain of immense stones resembles a giant serpent.
95.text: Onix! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A rock and ground type Pokémon. This chain of immense stones resembles a giant serpent.

96.name: Drowzee
96.description: If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.
96.text: Drowzee! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A psychic type Pokémon. If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.

97.name: Hypno
97.description: Avoid eye contact if you come across one.
97.text: Hypno! Drowzee's second evolutionary stage. A psychic type Pokémon. Avoid eye contact if you come across one.

98.name: Krabby
98.description: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.
98.text: Krabby! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A water type Pokémon. If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

100.description: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball.

101.description: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn.
101.text: Electrode! Voltorb's second evolutionary stage. An electric type Pokémon. The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn.

102.name: Exeggcute
102.description: These Pokémon get nervous when they’re not in a group of six.

103.text: Exeggutor! Exeggcute's second evolutionary stage. A grass and psychic type Pokémon. When they work together, Exeggutor’s three heads can put out powerful psychic energy.

104.text: Cubone! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A ground type Pokémon. This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother.

105.text: Marowak! Cubone's second evolutionary stage. A ground type Pokémon. When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it.

106.text: Hitmonlee! Tyrogue's second evolutionary stage. A fighting type Pokémon. The legs freely contract and stretch.

107.name: Hitmonchan

108.name: Lickitung

108.text: Lickitung! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A normal type Pokémon. Wields its long tongue deftly, as though it were an arm.

109.name: Koffing
109.text: Koffing! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A poison type Pokémon. It adores polluted air.

110.name: Weezing
110.description: It can’t suck in air quite as well as a Galarian Weezing, but the toxins it creates are more potent than those of its counterpart.

120.name: Staryu

121.text: Starmie! Staryu's second evolutionary stage. A water and psychic type Pokémon. Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed.

801.text: Magearna! A pokémon that does not evolve. A steel and fairy type Pokémon. It synchronizes its consciousness with others to understand their feelings.

802.name: Marshadow
802.description: This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow, so it went undiscovered for a long time.
802.text: Marshadow! A pokémon that does not evolve. A fighting and ghost type Pokémon. This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow, so it went undiscovered for a long time.

803.name: Poipole
803.description: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.
803.text: Poipole! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A poison type Pokémon. An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.

804.name: Naganadel
804.description: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles.
804.text: Naganadel! Poipole's second evolutionary stage. A poison and dragon type Pokémon. One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles.

805.name: Stakataka
805.description: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute’s true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.
805.text: Stakataka! A pokémon that does not evolve. A rock and steel type Pokémon. When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute’s true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.

806.name: Blacephalon
806.description: A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents’ surprise to rob them of their vitality.
806.text: Blacephalon! A pokémon that does not evolve. A fire and ghost type Pokémon. A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents’ surprise to rob them of their vitality.

807.name: Zeraora
807.description: Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs.
807.text: Zeraora! A pokémon that does not evolve. An electric type Pokémon. Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs.

808.name: Meltan
808.description: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.
808.text: Meltan! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A steel type Pokémon. They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.

809.name: Melmetal
809.description: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal’s heavy hex-nut arms.
809.text: Melmetal! Meltan's second evolutionary stage. A steel type Pokémon. Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal’s heavy hex-nut arms.

810.name: Grookey
810.description: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick.
810.text: Grookey! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A grass type Pokémon. It attacks with rapid beats of its stick.

811.name: Thwackey
811.description: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.
811.text: Thwackey! Grookey's second evolutionary stage. A grass type Pokémon. The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

812.name: Rillaboom
812.description: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop.
812.text: Rillaboom! Grookey's third evolutionary stage. A grass type Pokémon. The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop.

813.name: Scorbunny
813.description: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose.
813.text: Scorbunny! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A fire type Pokémon. It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose.

814.name: Raboot
814.description: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.
814.text: Raboot! Scorbunny's second evolutionary stage. A fire type Pokémon. It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

815.name: Cinderace
815.description: It’s skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on.
815.text: Cinderace! Scorbunny's third evolutionary stage. A fire type Pokémon. It’s skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on.

816.name: Sobble
816.description: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.
816.text: Sobble! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A water type Pokémon. When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.

817.name: Drizzile
817.description: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.
817.text: Drizzile! Sobble's second evolutionary stage. A water type Pokémon. Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.

818.name: Inteleon
818.description: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes’ weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.
818.text: Inteleon! Sobble's third evolutionary stage. A water type Pokémon. Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes’ weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

819.name: Skwovet
819.description: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks.
819.text: Skwovet! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A normal type Pokémon. It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks.

820.name: Greedent
820.description: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.
820.text: Greedent! Skwovet's second evolutionary stage. A normal type Pokémon. Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.

821.name: Rookidee
821.description: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.
821.text: Rookidee! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A flying type Pokémon. Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

822.name: Corvisquire
822.description: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.
822.text: Corvisquire! Rookidee's second evolutionary stage. A flying type Pokémon. The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.

823.name: Corviknight
823.description: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region’s airborne taxi service.
823.text: Corviknight! Rookidee's third evolutionary stage. A flying and steel type Pokémon. With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region’s airborne taxi service.

824.name: Blipbug
824.description: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.
824.text: Blipbug! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A bug type Pokémon. Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

825.name: Dottler
825.description: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.
825.text: Dottler! Blipbug's second evolutionary stage. A bug and psychic type Pokémon. As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

826.name: Orbeetle
826.description: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what’s around it—and what’s around it can include things over six miles away.
826.text: Orbeetle! Blipbug's third evolutionary stage. A bug and psychic type Pokémon. It emits psychic energy to observe and study what’s around it—and what’s around it can include things over six miles away.

827.name: Nickit
827.description: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others.
827.text: Nickit! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A dark type Pokémon. Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others.

828.name: Thievul
828.description: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs.
828.text: Thievul! Nickit's second evolutionary stage. A dark type Pokémon. With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs.

829.name: Gossifleur
829.description: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song.
829.text: Gossifleur! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A grass type Pokémon. It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song.

830.name: Eldegoss
830.description: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.
830.text: Eldegoss! Gossifleur's second evolutionary stage. A grass type Pokémon. The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

831.name: Wooloo
831.description: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won’t be able to move.
831.text: Wooloo! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A normal type Pokémon. If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won’t be able to move.

832.name: Dubwool
832.description: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender.
832.text: Dubwool! Wooloo's second evolutionary stage. A normal type Pokémon. Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender.

833.name: Chewtle
833.description: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.
833.text: Chewtle! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A water type Pokémon. It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

834.name: Drednaw
834.description: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.
834.text: Drednaw! Chewtle's second evolutionary stage. A water and rock type Pokémon. This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

835.name: Yamper
835.description: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats.
835.text: Yamper! The first stage of its evolutionary family. An electric type Pokémon. This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats.

836.name: Boltund
836.description: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength.
836.text: Boltund! Yamper's second evolutionary stage. An electric type Pokémon. It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength.

837.name: Rolycoly
837.description: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain.
837.text: Rolycoly! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A rock type Pokémon. It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain.

838.name: Carkol
838.description: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph.
838.text: Carkol! Rolycoly's second evolutionary stage. A rock and fire type Pokémon. By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph.

839.name: Coalossal
839.description: While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.
839.text: Coalossal! Rolycoly's third evolutionary stage. A rock and fire type Pokémon. While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

840.name: Applin
840.description: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple.
840.text: Applin! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A grass and dragon type Pokémon. As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple.

841.name: Flapple
841.description: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid.
841.text: Flapple! Applin's second evolutionary stage. A grass and dragon type Pokémon. It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid.

842.name: Appletun
842.description: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy.
842.text: Appletun! Applin's second evolutionary stage. A grass and dragon type Pokémon. Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy.

843.name: Silicobra
843.description: It spews sand from its nostrils.
843.text: Silicobra! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A ground type Pokémon. It spews sand from its nostrils.

844.name: Sandaconda
844.description: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.
844.text: Sandaconda! Silicobra's second evolutionary stage. A ground type Pokémon. Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

845.name: Cramorant
845.description: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole.
845.text: Cramorant! A pokémon that does not evolve. A flying and water type Pokémon. This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole.

846.name: Arrokuda
846.description: After it’s eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish.
846.text: Arrokuda! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A water type Pokémon. After it’s eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish.

847.name: Barraskewda
847.description: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.
847.text: Barraskewda! Arrokuda's second evolutionary stage. A water type Pokémon. It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

848.name: Toxel
848.description: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity.
848.text: Toxel! The first stage of its evolutionary family. An electric and poison type Pokémon. It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity.

849.name: Toxtricity
849.description: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.
849.text: Toxtricity! Toxel's second evolutionary stage. An electric and poison type Pokémon. This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

850.name: Sizzlipede
850.description: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils.
850.text: Sizzlipede! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A fire and bug type Pokémon. It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils.

851.name: Centiskorch
851.description: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.
851.text: Centiskorch! Sizzlipede's second evolutionary stage. A fire and bug type Pokémon. While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

852.name: Clobbopus
852.description: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn’t alarmed when that happens—it knows they’ll grow back.
852.text: Clobbopus! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A fighting type Pokémon. Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn’t alarmed when that happens—it knows they’ll grow back.

853.name: Grapploct
853.description: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land.
853.text: Grapploct! Clobbopus's second evolutionary stage. A fighting type Pokémon. Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land.

854.name: Sinistea
854.description: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware.
854.text: Sinistea! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A ghost type Pokémon. The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware.

855.name: Polteageist
855.description: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.
855.text: Polteageist! Sinistea's second evolutionary stage. A ghost type Pokémon. Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.

856.name: Hatenna
856.description: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can.
856.text: Hatenna! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A psychic type Pokémon. If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can.

857.name: Hattrem
857.description: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down.
857.text: Hattrem! Hatenna's second evolutionary stage. A psychic type Pokémon. Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down.

858.name: Hatterene
858.description: If you’re too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle.
858.text: Hatterene! Hatenna's third evolutionary stage. A psychic and fairy type Pokémon. If you’re too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle.

859.name: Impidimp
859.description: It sneaks into people’s homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.
859.text: Impidimp! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A dark and fairy type Pokémon. It sneaks into people’s homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

860.name: Morgrem
860.description: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods.
860.text: Morgrem! Impidimp's second evolutionary stage. A dark and fairy type Pokémon. With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods.

861.name: Grimmsnarl
861.description: Its hairs work like muscle fibers.
861.text: Grimmsnarl! Impidimp's third evolutionary stage. A dark and fairy type Pokémon. Its hairs work like muscle fibers.

862.name: Obstagoon
862.description: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights.
862.text: Obstagoon! Zigzagoon's third evolutionary stage. A dark and normal type Pokémon. It evolved after experiencing numerous fights.

863.name: Perrserker
863.description: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.
863.text: Perrserker! Meowth's second evolutionary stage. A steel type Pokémon. After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

864.name: Cursola
864.description: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy.
864.text: Cursola! Corsola's second evolutionary stage. A ghost type Pokémon. Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy.

865.name: Sirfetch’d
865.description: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk.
865.text: Sirfetch’d! Farfetch’d's second evolutionary stage. A fighting type Pokémon. After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk.

866.name: Mr. Rime
866.description: Its amusing movements make it very popular.
866.text: Mr. Rime! Mime jr.'s third evolutionary stage. An ice and psychic type Pokémon. Its amusing movements make it very popular.

867.name: Runerigus
867.description: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.
867.text: Runerigus! Yamask's second evolutionary stage. A ground and ghost type Pokémon. Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.

868.name: Milcery
868.description: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.
868.text: Milcery! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A fairy type Pokémon. They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.

869.name: Alcremie
869.description: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.
869.text: Alcremie! Milcery's second evolutionary stage. A fairy type Pokémon. When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

870.name: Falinks
870.description: The six of them work together as one Pokémon.
870.text: Falinks! A pokémon that does not evolve. A fighting type Pokémon. The six of them work together as one Pokémon.

871.name: Pincurchin
871.description: It stores electricity in each spine.
871.text: Pincurchin! A pokémon that does not evolve. An electric type Pokémon. It stores electricity in each spine.

872.name: Snom
872.description: It eats snow that piles up on the ground.
872.text: Snom! The first stage of its evolutionary family. An ice and bug type Pokémon. It eats snow that piles up on the ground.

873.name: Frosmoth
873.description: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains.
873.text: Frosmoth! Snom's second evolutionary stage. An ice and bug type Pokémon. It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains.

874.name: Stonjourner
874.description: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.
874.text: Stonjourner! A pokémon that does not evolve. A rock type Pokémon. Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

875.name: Eiscue
875.description: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice.
875.text: Eiscue! A pokémon that does not evolve. An ice type Pokémon. This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice.

876.name: Indeedee
876.description: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it.
876.text: Indeedee! A pokémon that does not evolve. A psychic and normal type Pokémon. Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it.

877.name: Morpeko
877.description: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they’re precious treasures.
877.text: Morpeko! A pokémon that does not evolve. An electric and dark type Pokémon. It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they’re precious treasures.

878.name: Cufant
878.description: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it.
878.text: Cufant! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A steel type Pokémon. If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it.

879.name: Copperajah
879.text: Copperajah! Cufant's second evolutionary stage. A steel type Pokémon. These Pokémon live in herds.

880.name: Dracozolt
880.description: The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity.
880.text: Dracozolt! A pokémon that does not evolve. An electric and dragon type Pokémon. The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity.

881.name: Arctozolt
881.description: This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body.
881.text: Arctozolt! A pokémon that does not evolve. An electric and ice type Pokémon. This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body.

882.name: Dracovish
882.description: Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon can’t breathe unless it’s underwater.
882.text: Dracovish! A pokémon that does not evolve. A water and dragon type Pokémon. Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon can’t breathe unless it’s underwater.

883.name: Arctovish
883.description: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go extinct anyway.
883.text: Arctovish! A pokémon that does not evolve. A water and ice type Pokémon. The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go extinct anyway.

884.name: Duraludon
884.description: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility.
884.text: Duraludon! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A steel and dragon type Pokémon. The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility.

885.name: Dreepy
885.description: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it.
885.text: Dreepy! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A dragon and ghost type Pokémon. If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it.

886.name: Drakloak
886.description: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it’ll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.
886.text: Drakloak! Dreepy's second evolutionary stage. A dragon and ghost type Pokémon. Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it’ll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.

887.name: Dragapult
887.description: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult’s horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.
887.text: Dragapult! Dreepy's third evolutionary stage. A dragon and ghost type Pokémon. Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult’s horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.

888.name: Zacian
888.description: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years.
888.text: Zacian! A pokémon that does not evolve. A fairy type Pokémon. This Pokémon has slumbered for many years.

889.name: Zamazenta
889.description: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue.
889.text: Zamazenta! A pokémon that does not evolve. A fighting type Pokémon. This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue.

890.name: Eternatus
890.description: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago.
890.text: Eternatus! A pokémon that does not evolve. A poison and dragon type Pokémon. It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago.

891.name: Kubfu
891.description: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.
891.text: Kubfu! The first stage of its evolutionary family. A fighting type Pokémon. If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.

892.name: Urshifu
892.description: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.
892.text: Urshifu! Kubfu's second evolutionary stage. A fighting and dark type Pokémon. Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

893.name: Zarude
893.description: Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil.
893.text: Zarude! A pokémon that does not evolve. A dark and grass type Pokémon. Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil.

894.name: Regieleki
894.description: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy.
894.text: Regieleki! A pokémon that does not evolve. An electric type Pokémon. Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy.

895.name: Regidrago
895.description: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy.
895.text: Regidrago! A pokémon that does not evolve. A dragon type Pokémon. Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy.

896.name: Glastrier
896.description: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.
896.text: Glastrier! A pokémon that does not evolve. An ice type Pokémon. Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.

897.name: Spectrier
897.description: As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures.
897.text: Spectrier! A pokémon that does not evolve. A ghost type Pokémon. As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures.

898.name: Calyrex
898.description: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times.
898.text: Calyrex! A pokémon that does not evolve. A psychic and grass type Pokémon. Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times.

899.name: Wyrdeer
899.description: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers.
899.text: Wyrdeer! Stantler's second evolutionary stage. A normal and psychic type Pokémon. The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers.

900.name: Kleavor
900.description: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone.
900.text: Kleavor! Scyther's second evolutionary stage. A bug and rock type Pokémon. A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone.

901.name: Ursaluna
901.description: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
901.text: Ursaluna! Teddiursa's third evolutionary stage. A ground and normal type Pokémon. I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

902.name: Basculegion
902.description: Basculegion is known as the Big Fish Pokémon.
902.text: Basculegion! Basculin's second evolutionary stage. A water and ghost type Pokémon. Basculegion is known as the Big Fish Pokémon.

903.name: Sneasler
903.description: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands.
903.text: Sneasler! Sneasel's second evolutionary stage. A fighting and poison type Pokémon. Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands.

904.name: Overqwil
904.description: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
904.text: Overqwil! Qwilfish's second evolutionary stage. A dark and poison type Pokémon. Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
